14: [decisions]
15: product = "PatientGPT: implement the full UI and workflows referenced by docs/design."
16: surfaces = "React web, Tauri desktop, and Flutter mobile with a shared shell-independent Rust core and typed host adapters."
17: runtime = "UAR owns agent execution and tool governance; use A2UI/AG-UI ContentBlock contracts."
18: state = "Entity graph owns durable entities and freshness; Zustand is transient UI state; Flutter uses Riverpod. No query cache."
19: clinical_source = "Reuse ASO clinical records and authorized workbench commands; the proposed PatientGPT schema adds conversation and workflow data without duplicating clinical truth."
20: design = "Preserve docs/design branding, Flat 2.0 layout, light/dark themes, and existing semantic status colors."
21: teams = "Agent teams by default. Project team definitions and installation are deferred."
22: verification = "Local integration testing only; CI may build, lint, typecheck, format, and package."
